editorial:
This is a personal notebook. A reflection is a point of view, not a claim to have the final answer.

## Experience and evidence

Personal observations, interpretations of research and illustrative examples should be distinguishable. Research-based claims deserve sources and dates. Older essays are retained with their original publication dates.

## Corrections

Substantive changes should carry an updated date and a correction note on the article itself. If you spot a mistake or a missing source, please use the contact page.

## What appears here

Only published writing belongs in the public archive. Ideas, drafts and planning calendars stay unpublished. A series is one thread through the writing, rather than the identity of this site.

## Independence

The opinions here are my own. References to a person, organisation or book do not imply endorsement.
privacy:
This website does not include advertising, analytics scripts, tracking pixels, public accounts or a contact-submission database.

## Reading the site

The website itself does not set tracking cookies. The hosting provider may process technical request information, such as IP addresses, for delivery and security. Provider-specific retention details must be confirmed before public launch.

## Getting in touch

If an email link is available, it opens your email application. Your message is handled by the chosen email provider, rather than stored in this website. Please avoid sending sensitive information.

## External links

Other websites have their own privacy practices. This website has no CMS, editor login or third-party editing scripts.
